args.text: Can you pull every ticket and feature request on Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Driftmoor Marine Freight from the Coastal channels and Moss's Coastal notes, labelled by account? Leave Pellow Home Living out even though it shares the PHL code. I need the list for Kwame's account review.

Bettina, here's what I found for Kwame's account review. Pellow Home Living is left out. Nothing in #coastal-team or #coastal-random mentions either account's tickets, so everything below comes from Moss's Coastal notes.

*Pellucid Harbor Logistics (PHL)*
• #4419: `Yard_Dwell_Summary` report times out when filtered by container length. Open. Source: Moss's Coastal cheat sheet.
• PD-8841: chassis pool holds on double-booked gates, Gate 4B. Source: your Dec 2025 cutover recap, not Moss's notes. It's included in case it's still relevant.

*Driftmoor Marine Freight (DMF)*
• Feature request #882: bulk-clear button for departed barges, asked for by their warehouse managers. Source: Moss's cheat sheet.
• #4419 again, per Moss's Nov 2 digest: barge slip 7 schedule sync, on Kwame's Puget Sound port account. In the same digest, DMF asked for a patched manifest CSV before the 06:00 shift. No ticket number is given for that request.
• The Terminal B tide-table import macro failure has no ticket number. Engineering supplied a manual CSV patch. Source: cheat sheet.

*Please check:* Moss's notes use #4419 for two different issues. The cheat sheet puts it on PHL as the report timeout. The digest puts it on DMF as the slip 7 sync. One of them is probably a typo, or the number belongs to a different system. Confirm with Kwame before it goes in the review.

The notes may not be complete. I could only search the files and channels I can read.
